messages.body:

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles across energy transition, market entry, external affairs, ESG and strategic partnerships. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across Europe, the GCC and wider markets.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
